title: Supabase Auth confirmation and magic link emails fail with Email address not authorized or hit a rate limit
symptoms: Email address not authorized when signing up anyone outside the project team
email rate limit exceeded after two or three signups in an hour
Emails reach team members but never real users
cause: Without custom SMTP, Supabase sends only to members of the organization's team and caps sending at 2 messages per hour. After you add custom SMTP the cap starts at 30 per hour until you raise it.
fix: Configure a custom SMTP provider before launch, then raise the email rate limit on the Auth rate limits page to match expected signups.
apply:
Dashboard: Authentication > Emails > SMTP Settings > Enable custom SMTP
Dashboard: Authentication > Rate Limits > Rate limit for sending emails
affected: Hosted Supabase projects using the built-in email service (no custom SMTP configured)
